acceptanceCriteria: cem <action> --help prints per-action help; corvint-cem-candidate assemble-stable output carries the same top-level ok envelope as cem actions (additive); cem cite on a stable map refuses with a distinct not-a-producer-map code instead of unsupported-spec; spec amended with requirement IDs; tests cover each.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1335. cem <action> --help prints the whole multi-action usage; assemble-stable output lacks the top-level ok member the cem subcommands have; cem cite on an assembled cem/1.0 stable map refuses unsupported-spec although the real cause is that the input is not a producer map.
title: cem: per-action help, one result envelope with ok, and not-a-producer-map refusal for cite
